description: Submit one large local workflow through ExactPDF direct GCS upload: compress (PDF ≤1 GiB), folder_batch (ZIP ≤256 MiB, max_credits 1–100), source_pack (text-layer PDF ≤256 MiB), or smart_redact (PDF ≤256 MiB/100 pages). Requires an explicit idempotency_key. Smart Redact inspect returns only a source SHA-256 and coordinate regions; apply requires reviewed:true, that exact SHA, and explicit reviewed regions. Inspect and apply are separate hosted jobs; each API/MCP job costs one credit only after its output is verified. It does not promise PII detection or auto-apply redactions.

idempotency_key.description: Stable client-generated key for this exact intent. Never reuse it with changed file size/options.

max_credits.description: Explicit maximum credits: exactly 1 except folder_batch, which permits 1–100.

options.description: compress/folder: targetId or customTargetBytes; source_pack: mode; smart_redact: inspect or reviewed apply options.

path.description: Absolute local PDF or ZIP path. It is read in bounded 8 MiB chunks, never loaded whole.

name: exactpdf_workflow_submit
